==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am playing an RPG style card battle game. In the game I have my own monster. It is a winged black lion with skeletal arms and legs.

My monster looks creepy and ferocious, but it is losing to a simple soldier card. Each turn I seem to be getting bad rolls. The soldier seems to land every hit and I seem to miss every attack.

I lose the game. Despite my monster being defeated, I don't feel particularly bad about it. I had fun and that's all that matters.
